Study Information:
**Dear [Patient First Name]**

Living with vitiligo can be a deeply personal journey — one that affects more than just the skin. We understand the challenges that come with visible changes in pigmentation and the ongoing search for options that truly make a difference. That’s why staying informed can be a major step in managing your health. 
We invite you to join WeConnect, an online registry that shares important health-related information, provides peer support, and updates of clinical trials that may match your health needs. You will also be able to learn more about an active vitiligo clinical trial currently enrolling people just like you.
